content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Recent federal legislation aimed at enhancing national security through expanded surveillance powers has raised concerns among civil liberties groups about potential misuse of authority.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: Supporters of the new laws argue that they are necessary to combat rising cyber threats and protect citizens from terrorism.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Critics, however, warn that these measures could erode individual privacy rights and lead to an Orwellian society where government overreach becomes the norm.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: Civil rights organizations have called for stringent oversight mechanisms to ensure that these powers are used responsibly.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_4
content_blocks.text: Legal experts suggest that a balanced approach is needed to safeguard both public safety and personal freedoms.

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: "Surveillance without accountability is a recipe for tyranny." - Privacy Rights Coalition Spokesperson
